infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app uses the microphone to record voice messages for transcription.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to capture photos for sharing in conversations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app accesses your photo library to let you share photos in conversations.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: This app uses HealthKit to read your health and fitness data to provide personalized insights and track your wellness goals.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: This app uses HealthKit to update your health data for comprehensive wellness tracking.
